rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: KeyReaper manages API credentials through a secure proxy that injects secrets server-side, eliminating raw keys from application code. The MCP integration enables credential lifecycle operations including exposure detection, rotation, rollback, and audit trail queries. Plans range from individual to enterprise tiers with a 7-day free trial.
